name: control-connect-supplied-login
description: A connection opened for a login supplied on session create (SessionCreateRequest.login) uses the connect message a stored password uses, with no new field: user is login.user, auth is {kind password, password}, and nothing else of the login crosses the socket. So every worker that serves a stored password (from proto_version 0.2) serves a supplied login, and no proto_version step is needed. The password travels here only, as every target credential does (V10), and a collection carries it only as the synthetic constant. A collected run must follow the same order as C3/control-connect-openshell-sequence.

messages.note: the supplied login: user and password, in connect and nowhere else
the target accepted the password; a refusal is auth_failed, as for a stored credential
